description: Find related notes from a known note reference. Preferred: path (a search result's note_path field). Use this after opening a promising note when you need nearby context.

href.description: String note href, copied verbatim from a search result's href field

note_id.description: Same as pid: non-negative integer (uint64) note id, copied verbatim from a search result's note_id field. Not a path, slug, or match_id. Prefer path

path.description: String note path, e.g. "concepts/maska-i-glubina.md" — copy verbatim from a search result's note_path field. The default, preferred way to reference a note

pid.description: Non-negative integer (uint64) note id, copied verbatim from a search result's note_id field. Not a path, slug, or match_id — a value like ":" or "/hub/goethe.md" is a path, not a note id. Prefer path

name: similar
